indicators.unusual_parent_process: update.exe spawned powershell.exe with encoded commands

examples.detection_method: Monitor code signing verification failures or unexpected signatures on update binaries; correlate process creation logs to identify non-standard child processes spawned by update.exe; use network monitoring to detect connections to unknown external IPs post-update; implement behavioral analysis to detect beaconing activity from update processes.
